scenes.head: WHAT IT IS
scenes.narration: Solana is a blockchain for apps, payments and tokens. Its coin, S O L, pays fees and rewards the computers that run it.

scenes.head: THE IDEA
scenes.hook: PROOF OF HISTORY: A BUILT-IN CLOCK
scenes.narration: Its big idea is Proof of History. It stamps events in order, like a shared clock, so computers agree faster.

scenes.head: THE LIMIT
scenes.narration: The trade-off is that Solana has had network outages in the past. Speed alone does not mean reliability.
